s: the Kingdom is holy (flourishing in holiness to the Great Creator's glory)
q: And to the Great Creator (shall there be) a Realm such as that (whose strength I asked for victory), and which (at the last) shall flourish in its holiness to His (glory)!

s: the Kingdom belongs to Ahura Mazda (holy)
q: With Thy Good Mind and Thy (holy) Kingdom he follows the Righteous Order

s: Âramaiti questions the two spirits (steadily and searchingly in the spirit-world)
q: our) Piety steadily questions the two spirits (not here on earth) but (there in the spirit-world) where (they dwell as) in their home.

s: Âramaiti belongs to Ahura Mazda (as His attribute)
q: Thine, O Ahura! was Piety

s: Mãthra is a word (the best of all words declared by the All-wise One)
q: And that verily shall be the best of all words to Him which the All-(wise one) will declare to me in very deed, that word which is the Mãthra of Welfare and of Immortality

s: Ahura Mazda gives Good Mind (through His Spirit and Fire and Righteousness)
q: And that keenness, that deciding satisfaction, which Thou hast given by (Thy) Spirit, and (Thy) Fire, and by Thy Righteousness (itself) to the two battling (sides)

s: Mãthra proclaims beneficent power
q: that word which is the Mãthra of Welfare and of Immortality (for it proclaims His beneficent power).

s: Universal Weal and Immortality is given by Ahura Mazda (in the fulness of His Righteous Order)
q: But Ahura Mazda will give both Universal Weal and Immortality in the fulness of His Righteous Order

q: Of the two she chose the husbandman, the thrifty toiler in the fields, as a holy master endowed with the Good Mind's wealth.

s: Kine rejects the thieving nomad (as unfit to share the good creed)
q: Never, Mazda! shall the thieving nomad share the good creed. (For the Kine's choice would bestow it!)

s: the zealous and thrifty husbandman is a holy master (thrifty toiler in the fields, endowed with the Good Mind's wealth)
q: Of the two she chose the husbandman, the thrifty toiler in the fields, as a holy master endowed with the Good Mind's wealth.

s: the thieving nomad does not share the good creed (because the Kine rejects him)
q: Never, Mazda! shall the thieving nomad share the good creed.

s: the settlements of Righteousness are delivered to death by Lie (through harmful doctrinal vows)
q: those who by means of the doctrinal vows of the harmful Lie are delivering the settlements of Righteousness to death

q: Thine, O Ahura! was Piety; yea, Thine, O Creator of the Kine! was understanding and the Spirit

q: for him who cannot else reclaim his life, not else save with lawless harm to the tiller's herd, to the pious husbandman's flock

s: the evil-doer prepares the throne for the evil
q: What is the award for him who prepares the throne for the evil, for the evil-doer, O Ahura!

s: Ahura Mazda is the creator of Righteousness (through His understanding)
q: He is through His understanding the Creator of the Righteous Order.

s: Ahura Mazda supports Good Mind (in His saints)
q: And thus likewise He supports His Beneficent Mind (in His saints).

s: Bountiful Immortals is a rulers (rule aright)
q: those who rule aright, and who dispose (of all) aright

q: Asha Vahista (who is Righteousness the Best)

s: institutions of religion includes Bountiful Âramaiti (the Piety within us)
q: and those of the Bountiful Âramaiti (the Piety within us)

q: and those of Weal and Immortality

q: and those which appertain to the body of the Kine, and to the Kine's soul

s: Bountiful Immortals disposes of all (aright)
q: those who rule aright, and who dispose (of all) aright

s: institutions of religion includes Sraosha (Obedience the blessed)

q: Sraosha (Obedience) the blessed

s: institutions of religion includes Rashnu (the most just)
q: and of Rashnu the most just

s: institutions of religion includes Mithra (of the wide pastures)
q: and those of Mithra of the wide pastures

s: institutions of religion includes Mazdayasnian Faith (good)

q: and of the good and pious Prayer for blessings

q: and those of the good and pious Prayer which frees one from belying

s: Ahura Mazda is a Creator
q: who is Ahura Mazda, the Creator, the gracious helper, the maker of all good things

s: Ahura Mazda is a gracious helper
q: who is Ahura Mazda, the Creator, the gracious helper, the maker of all good things

s: Ahura Mazda makes all good things

s: Yasna LXXI is a The Yasna Concluding
q: Yasna LXXI (Sp. LXX). The Yasna Concluding.

s: Prayer is a well-timed Prayer (the prayer of that holy ritual lord; approached the nearest for help)
q: even that well-timed Prayer which is the prayer of that holy ritual lord, and which has approached the nearest (to us for our help).

s: Mãthra has descent complete and long descent
q: and we worship its complete and long descent.

s: Daêvas are opposed by Mãthra (through the Faith set up against them)
q: the entire system of the Faith set up against the Daêvas

s: words which Mazda spake designate evil thought, word, and deed
q: and which designate the evil thought, and word, and deed

s: Frashaostra is a holy

q: and which then cut down and fell every evil thought, and word, and deed.

s: waters includes springs of water (all springs and water-streams)
q: And we sacrifice to all the springs of water, and to the water-streams as well

s: Weal is a complete welfare (holy and ruling in its course in the ritual order)
q: And we sacrifice to Weal, the complete welfare, holy and ruling in its course in the ritual order

s: Yasna Haptanghâiti is a holy lord of the ritual order (heroic)

s: Righteous Order is a Righteousness the Best
q: because of Asha Vahista (of Righteousness the Best).

s: Zarathustra is a saintly
q: Frashaostra, the holy, asked the saintly Zarathustra: Answer me, O thou most eminent Zarathustra, what is (in very truth) the memorised recital of the rites?

s: Kinvat Bridge is a bridge (crossed by the soul)

s: soul belongs to Zarathustra (kept away from Hell by Ahura Mazda)

s: soul passes over Kinvat Bridge (in a holy state)
q: holy shalt thou cause (thy) soul to pass over the Kinvat Bridge

s: Ahura Mazda is a holy lord of the ritual order
q: We worship Ahura Mazda with our sacrifice (as) the holy lord of the ritual order

q: and we sacrifice to Zarathustra likewise as to a holy lord of the ritual order

s: Fravashi of Zarathustra belongs to Zarathustra (the saint)
q: and we sacrifice also to the Fravashi of Zarathustra, the saint.

q: And we sacrifice to (all) the good heroic and bounteous Fravashis of the saints, of the bodily (world on earth), and of the mental (those in Heaven).

q: YASNA LXXII. (See Y. LXI.)

s: rival-monarch seeks sovereignty (through plotting by others)
q: That rival-monarch (thus we may supply the sense of lost verses) for whom some are plotting to secure the sovereignty

s: Ahura Mazda rules through Good Mind (within souls)

s: Good Mind is a mental power (within souls)

q: as of the Demon-gods beloved, forsaken by the Good Mind

s: Daêvas are estranged from Ahura Mazda (far astray from understanding)

q: and who, once in power, would deliver over home, village, town, and province to ruin and to death

s: Daêvas are estranged from Righteousness (far astray)
q: and (far astray) from His Righteousness!

s: Daêvas are ruled by Evil Spirit (with an evil mind and word)
q: since the Evil Spirit (has ruled) you with his evil mind. Yea, he has ruled you, (ye) who are of the Demon-gods, and with an evil word unto action

s: Evil Spirit rules Daêvas (with his evil mind)
q: since the Evil Spirit (has ruled) you with his evil mind. Yea, he has ruled you, (ye) who are of the Demon-gods

s: men is deprived of happy life (by the Daêvas)

s: men is deprived of Immortality (by the Daêvas)
q: and of Immortality (beyond it)

s: Grehma is loved by men (above Righteousness)
q: men by whom Grehmas are loved above Righteousness, and the Karpans

s: Grehma seeks kingdom (in Hell, the abode of the Worst Mind)
q: And the Grehma will seek for these things by means of his (evil) kingdom in the abode of (Hell which is) the Worst Mind

s: Grehma opposes Ahura Mazda (through Kavis and scheming plans)
q: His is Grehma; aye, his! And to (oppose) Thee he will establish the Kavis and (their) scheming plans.

s: rival-monarch would deliver to ruin village (once in power)
q: and who, once in power, would deliver over home, village, town, and province to ruin and to death

s: Karpans is loved by men
q: men by whom Grehmas are loved above Righteousness, and the Karpans

s: Karpans are driven out by Zarathustra (with their disciples)
q: And therefore will I drive from hence the Karpans’ and Kavis’ disciples.

s: Kavis are established by Grehma (to oppose Ahura Mazda)
q: to (oppose) Thee he will establish the Kavis and (their) scheming plans

s: Kavis are driven out by Zarathustra (with their disciples)
q: And therefore will I drive from hence the Karpans’ and Kavis’ disciples.

q: He declares that the (sacred) Kine and the Sun are the worst of things which eye can see

s: Kine are slain by wicked men (under a blessing)
q: who have slain the Kine's life by a blessing

s: doctrines are destroyed by evil teacher (through teaching)
q: An evil teacher (as that leader is), he will destroy (our) doctrines

s: doctrines are perverted by evil teacher (through his teachings)
q: and by his teachings he will pervert the (true) understanding of life

s: doctrines are declared by evil men (through basely delivering them)
q: as to those doctrines which (such) men may be (basely) delivering

q: and who, once in power, would deliver over home, village, town, and province to ruin and to death

s: rival-monarch would deliver to ruin province (once in power)
q: and who, once in power, would deliver over home, village, town, and province to ruin and to death

s: rival-monarch practices false religion (to accomplish his ends)
q: is active in his efforts, and offering the devotions of his false religion to accomplish his ends.

s: Zarathustra has friendship with Ahura Mazda (in his mind)

s: Ahura Mazda is a Great Creator (living Lord)
q: Ahura Mazda, the Great Creator, the living Lord

q: Let the man who is the best toward the righteous saint, whether lord's kinsman, or as village labourer

q: a Ratu such as Ahura sought to satisfy their wail

q: let such an one be (for us) in the work-field of the Righteous Order

s: Ratu is in pastures of Thy Good Mind
q: in the pastures of Thy Good Mind.

s: Zarathustra abjures Evil Mind
q: I who abjure the Evil Mind as well

s: Zarathustra abjures lordly kinsman's arrogance
q: the lordly kinsman's arrogance

s: Zarathustra abjures lying sin (a familiar fault among the people)
q: and that lying sin which is (alas!) the next thing to the people (their most familiar fault)

s: Zarathustra is a spiritual chieftain (besought-for by the Kine)
q: that chief besought-for by the Kine, and named as Zarathustra by the Lord

s: Zarathustra abjures blaming ally's falsehood
q: and the blaming ally's falsehood

s: Zarathustra abjures Kine's meadow care (the worst care of her meadows)
q: and from the Kine the worst care of her meadows (the crime of stint in labour)

s: Zarathustra calls on Obedience (as the greatest of all assisting guardians)
q: I, who (abjuring these sins), call earnestly on Thine Obedience of all (assisting guardians) the greatest one for our help

s: Obedience is a assisting guardian (the greatest one)
q: Thine Obedience of all (assisting guardians) the greatest one

s: Zarathustra seeks long life (in the Realm of Good Mind)
q: gaining (thereby) long life in the Realm of (Thy) Good Mind

s: Zarathustra seeks straight paths (from Righteous Order)
q: and paths that are straight from their Righteous Order

s: Realm of Good Mind is dwelling place of Ahura Mazda
q: wherein Ahura Mazda dwells

s: Zarathustra has regulations (best and very own)
q: Come Ye, then, to my best (regulations. Come to my men, and my laws), my very own, O Mazda!

s: Zarathustra has laws (best and very own)
q: Come Ye, then, to my best (regulations. Come to my men, and my laws), my very own, O Mazda!

s: offerings of worship are manifest among Zarathustrian Faith (manifold)
q: let the manifold offerings of worship be manifest among us.

q: show me the worthy aims of our faith, so that I may approach and fulfil them with (Thy) Good Mind

q: And give Ye as Your offering (of grace to me) the abiding gifts of Your Immortality and Welfare!

s: two leaders cause Righteous Order (to flourish)
q: the spirit of the two leaders who cause the holy ritual Truth to flourish

s: salvation blesses bodily and personal life (through Good Mind, Sovereign Power, and Sanctity)
q: cause (our) bodily and personal life to be blest with salvation through (Thy) Good Mind, (Thy) Sovereign Power, and (Thy) Sanctity.

s: Ahura Mazda is a most beneficent Ahura
q: And, O Thou who art the most beneficent Ahura Mazda!

s: Âramaiti is a piety (beneficent)
q: and thou who art Âramaiti (our piety)

s: Righteousness furthers settlements
q: and also the Righteous Order who dost further on the settlements

s: Ahura Mazda gives power (through Âramaiti)
q: Through Âramaiti give me power, O most bountiful Spirit Mazda

q: Thus, as an offering, Zarathustra gives the life of his very body.

s: Zarathustra's body is offered as Ahura Mazda
q: Thus, as an offering, Zarathustra gives the life of his very body.

s: Zarathustra offers Good Mind (with priority and eminence gained by holiness)
q: And he offers, likewise, O Mazda! the priority of the Good Mind, (his eminence gained) by his holiness (with Thy folk)

q: that chief besought-for by the Kine, and named as Zarathustra by the Lord

s: Zarathustra offers Obedience (in deed and speech)

s: Zarathustra offers Sovereign Power (as an established divine attribute)
q: and with these (Thine established) Sovereign Power!

q: he who does evil to the wicked by word, or with thought (and plan), and (who therein does not dally, but toils labouring as) with both the hands

q: such as these are offering (a gift) to their religious faith in the love (and with the approving view) of Ahura Mazda

s: Immortality is a gift (given through holy deeds, words, and sacrifice)
q: Immortality, the Righteous Order, and the (established) Kingdom of Welfare, which Thou, O Mazda! hast given through (holy) deeds, words, and the sacrifice

q: And unto Thee, O Ahura! will we offer the (thankful) meat-offering with self-humbling praise

s: meat-offering is offered to Righteousness (with self-humbling praise)
q: And unto Thee, O Ahura! will we offer the (thankful) meat-offering with self-humbling praise, and to Thy Righteousness (like Thee a person)

s: settlements are guarded by Good Mind (within the Kingdom)
q: for all the settlements in Thy kingdom which are guarded by Thy Good Mind

s: Fire is strong through Righteousness (as a powerful sacred force)

s: Ahura Mazda has kingdom Your Kingdom
q: What is then Your Kingdom, O Mazda?

s: Immortality is given by Ahura Mazda (through holy deeds, words, and sacrifice)
q: Immortality, the Righteous Order, and the (established) Kingdom of Welfare, which Thou, O Mazda! hast given through (holy) deeds, words, and the sacrifice

s: Khrafstras pollute men (through destruction and pollution of life)
q: Khrafstra-polluted mortals

s: Righteousness is a gift (given through holy deeds, words, and sacrifice)
q: Immortality, the Righteous Order, and the (established) Kingdom of Welfare, which Thou, O Mazda! hast given through (holy) deeds, words, and the sacrifice

q: And for Thee hath Âramaiti (who is Our Piety) increased both the Universal Weal and (its continuance in) Immortality
